lanes.title: Governance gates

base_freshness.command: git fetch origin dev; git rev-parse HEAD; git rev-parse origin/dev; git status --porcelain=v1; git rev-list --left-right --count HEAD...origin/dev

milestones: RED fixture first in later approved implementation
Existing-fixup reconciliation before any F-GJC-G1-* append
Independent reviewer and section 4A audit before closure
success: Only G1 governance paths are in scope.
HEAD equals live origin/dev tip at lease time.
Worktree has no diff and no implementation commit before RED fixture work.
Implementer brief carries off-limits, shared-hotspot prohibition, append-only row discipline, existing-fixup reconciliation, RED-fixture-first, independent reviewer separation, and section 4A audit.
failure: Touches an orchestrator-owned shared hotspot as an implementer.
Appends a non-F-GJC-G1-* row or edits an existing row.
Starts from stale base, dirty worktree, or premature implementation commit.
lanes.implementer_brief: Scope: libs/oya-governance-* and tools/oya-governance-*-app only. Start by proving HEAD == live origin/dev and no diff. Do RED fixture first in later approved implementation. Do not touch intelligence/, cloud/cloud-iam, oya/ci-webhook-gateway, libs/oya-ci-config/src/bundled/gate-disposition.json, or cloud/cloud-ci/gates/**. Append only F-GJC-G1-* rows to registry/fixuptasks.jsonl after reconciling existing IDs and citing one parent evidence row plus one root cause. No self-review; independent reviewer and section 4A output-quality/process audit are required.
